name: rose-enhanced
description: A privacy-first Windows companion for League of Legends.
author: Rose Enhanced contributors

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @rose-enhanced/contracts && npm run build --workspace @rose-enhanced/core && npm run build --workspace @rose-enhanced/remote && npm run build --workspace @rose-enhanced/ui && npm run build --workspace @rose-enhanced/client-tab && npm run build --workspace @rose-enhanced/mobile && npm run build --workspace @rose-enhanced/relay && npm run build --workspace @rose-enhanced/desktop
scripts.package: npm run build --workspace @rose-enhanced/client-tab && npm run package --workspace @rose-enhanced/desktop
scripts.make: npm run build --workspace @rose-enhanced/client-tab && npm run make --workspace @rose-enhanced/desktop
